scope: offline warm dense F32 loaded-model generation including prefill; excludes compilation, model loading, HTTP, queue admission and network hydration
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX5090; CUDA13.4 SM120; driver615.71.09
sample_order: independent/cohorts/merged then merged/cohorts/independent, alternating for five repetitions

memory.sampling_note: /proc status and smaps_rollup sampled about50ms plus nvidia-smi work; compute VRAM requested no faster than150ms. Values can miss shorter peaks; sample phase uses observed stderr boundaries. Whole-process peaks include model load; measured-only peaks exclude it. External instrumentation runs during all modes.

limitations: Small fixed repeated/unique token corpus; no model-quality or long-context inference.
Model weights load once and remain shared across all modes.
Engine telemetry and external memory polling run during every mode; workstation CPU/frequency/GPU clocks not pinned.
Private RSS is Private_Clean+Private_Dirty+Private_Hugetlb from smaps_rollup; sampled about50ms plus query overhead.
Compute VRAM is per-PID nvidia-smi sampled no faster than150ms; short peaks can be missed.
Whole-process memory peaks include the existing checkpoint loader; measured phase peaks exclude loading.
TTFT uses one outer workload clock, includes waiting for earlier rows/cohorts, and is distinct from process launch or network TTFT.
No production inference readiness, merge, rebake, model-wide hydration barrier or HTTP throughput claim.
